<b>Flick the Fixer</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. He is a resident of [[Bone Bottom]] who specialises in construction and repairs.<ref name="fixer" />

== Background ==
Flick is one of the many pilgrims who arrived in [[Bone Bottom]] to start his pilgrimage to [[the Citadel]], but eventually ended up as the settlement fixer, despite knowing that it is shameful for a pilgrim to tarry so long in one place.<ref name = "fixer" >Flick the Fixer: <i>"Aye, aye. You're a sharp bug! A wishwall. It's past time this old camp had one. As the resident fixer, I've taken it upon myself to sort it out."</i></ref><ref>Flick the Fixer: <i>"Don't go thinkin' fear's keepin' me from my own pilgrimage! S'just there's a lotta work still to do here and few bugs able to do it."</i></ref> He cares for the other pilgrims and is ready to use his building skills to aid them.<ref>Flick the Fixer: <i>"And another poor pilgrim lost, eh? Just the thought of it makes me weary. Better to put my head down and work 'til the job's done..."</i></ref><ref><i>[[A Lifesaving Bridge]]</i> [[wish]] description: <i>"I've heard tell pilgrims sometimes fall down that big hole beside the settlement. Nasty way to end your journey, before it even begins. I could build a bridge, if I only had the materials!"</i></ref><ref><i>[[An Icon of Hope]]</i> wish description: <i>"The road is hard for we pilgrims. I want to build a beautiful symbol of hope, to stand beside Bone Bottom and welcome all those who are about to begin their long journey."</i></ref> In his craft, he often uses [[Shell Shards]].<ref>Flick the Fixer: <i>"Common stuff, shell shards, but very practical. I can use 'em to patch almost anything up, and this camp's always in need of some mending."</i></ref>

== In-Game Events ==
Flick the Fixer can first be found building a [[wishwall]] in [[Bone Bottom]], believing that the settlement needs a place for prayers and wishes so that they are not left unanswered.<ref>Flick the Fixer: <i>"They're a popular thing about Pharloom, wishwalls. Useful too. So many prayers left unanswered. Gives 'em a place to go."</i></ref>

He finishes building the wishwall after [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] defeats the [[Bell Beast]], and places his own <i>[[Bone Bottom Repairs]]</i> wish on it. When Hornet grants this wish by donating the required amount of [[Shell Shards]], he tells Hornet that such kindness is not something one sees much of in this weary place, to which Hornet responds that she is doing it for her own purposes.<ref>Hornet and Flick the Fixer dialogue: <br><i>Flick the Fixer: "Those shards are valuable, alright. Brilliant for crafting and fixing, very versatile. More than that, though... it was a warm thing you did, the sort of kindness you don't see much in this weary place." <br>Hornet: "Was this kindness? I must take care to learn of this land and claim what advantage I can from it. Answering requests like yours can often fit those ends."</i></ref> Flick is surprised, but still thanks her and wishes her luck in her travels.<ref>Flick the Fixer: <i>"Oh, it's like that, is it? Well, even still, the help's well appreciated, miss. Best of luck in your travels, and may every wish of yours be granted!"</i></ref>

After the <i>Bone Bottom Repairs</i> wish is completed, upon re-entering Bone Bottom, Flick is no longer at the wishwall. He can be seen working in the background, and is present on a few occasions afterwards:<ref group=code>FSM<code>Fixer NPC Standing - Conversation</code> in <code>bonetown.bundle</code> checks various flags.</ref>
* Upon completion of the <i>[[An Icon of Hope]]</i> wish, Flick appears to express his gratitude. He gifts Hornet the [[Hornet Statuette]] and assures her she is always welcome in the settlement.<ref>Flick the Fixer: <i>"I'd been thinkin' on all your efforts, and set to making a little something to repay 'em. S'only a token, really! But I've put all me talent into it, much as I've got! Something to keep you company on the lonely roads above. Hold onto it on your travels, and remember that you're always welcome down here with us."</i></ref>
* After the [[Skull Tyrant]] attack, he can be found fixing the destroyed bench. Flick is glad that Hornet is unharmed after the battle and apologises for leaving her in danger, admitting that he is no warrior. Hornet, however, reassures him that he did the right thing, as the settlement needs a fixer, not a warrior.<ref>Hornet and Flick the Fixer dialogue: <br><i>Flick the Fixer: "Ah! Here she is, safe after all! I was worried your battle with that enormous beast had left you badly wounded. Shames me to have left you in danger there, missy, but I'm no warrior, and my tools ain't no match for a creature like that." <br>Hornet: "It is well that you kept yourself safe. This settlement needs a fixer now, not a warrior."</i></ref>
* If [[Pilby]] dies when the [[Skull Tyrant]] attacks Bone Bottom, Flick appears during the funeral held by [[Solemn Pilgrim]].

When Hornet delivers the [[Bone Bottom Supplies]] from [[Tipp & Pill]], Flick is there to receive the package. He mentions that pilgrims often arrive at the settlement with nothing, and that the supplies will make things easier for them.<ref>Flick the Fixer: <i>"Ah! Mighty thankful these folks'll be. Most arrive here with nothin' but their shell. Your delivery there'll make things a little easier on 'em."</i></ref> After receiving the package for the first time, he no longer leaves the area.

After the destruction of Bone Bottom in [[Act 3]], Flick and the other surviving residents relocate to [[the Marrow]] and set up the [[Survivor's Camp]]. When Hornet visits them, he remarks that it is no surprise she survived, considering her skill, and tells her about the fate of their settlement.<ref>Flick the Fixer: <i>"Ah, miss! Course you'd be one to survive through all this! Capable as you seem and all. It's a sad thing, but I can't say most folk down here've fared so fortunate. And our once fine camp below ain't no longer safe for any bug, all crushed and consumed by this black calamity."</i></ref> When Hornet lets him know that she intends to fix the black calamity, he expresses doubt that any one bug could do it, but is still heartened to know that she has fire enough to feel different.<ref>Flick the Fixer: <i>"Calming our raging world? That's a lofty goal, miss. I'm not thinkin' any one bug'd be able to stop these happenings, but it's heartenin' knowing you've still got fire enough to feel different."</i></ref> Hornet can deliver the [[Survivor's Camp Supplies]] from Tipp & Pill to Flick, to much appreciation from him.<ref>Flick the Fixer: <i>"Eh? What fortune is this? Our wish answered, even in a moment so dark! You've proved quite the saviour, miss, and you've certainly earned the appreciation of this whole sorry lot."</i></ref>

| Title1_Dialogue1 = {{HTalk|What's this you're building, sir? A sign of some kind?}}<br>

They're a popular thing about Pharloom, wishwalls. Useful too. So many prayers left unanswered. Gives 'em a place to go.

In Pharloom, wishes are granted to those truly devout, or so they say. And there ain't no harm in us dregs having wishes too.<br>
Why, I even went and added a little wish of my own to the wishwall! Fair's fair. I did build the thing. Seems like the kingdom should be granting my wish before anyone else's.
| Title1_Event4 = Exhausted dialogue before completing the <i>Bone Bottom Repairs</i> wish

| Title2_Event1 = First conversation
| Title2_Dialogue1 = Ah, miss! Course you'd be one to survive through all this! Capable as you seem and all.<br>

{{HTalk|Nowhere is safe, sir, but I am glad you few remain. Know I shall work to fix this, as best I'm able.}}<br>
Calming our raging world? That's a lofty goal, miss. I'm not thinkin' any one bug'd be able to stop these happenings, but it's heartenin' knowing you've still got fire enough to feel different.<br>
Rest here with us, long as you like. A little company's about the best thing we few're wishin' for now.

== Location ==
Flick the Fixer can first be found in [[Bone Bottom]]. In [[Act 3]], he and the other survivors move to [[the Marrow]] and set up the [[Survivor's Camp]].
